The index lists the April 5, 2011 General Municipal election (id 13881) and the May 17, 2011 Mayoral Runoff (id 7103). The city page says voters changed the form of government in November 2010, so a mayoral election in 2011 is expected, but no results could be opened. Third pass: re-fetched the election history index with curl (HTTP 200). Laserfiche DocView pages returned HTTP 200 with 'Access denied. [9013]' with a browser user agent, cookie jar and referer from the index; the same link with the index's searchid returned 'Entry not found. [9001]'. Chrome navigation worked but page reading was blocked by the extension for this domain. The Wayback availability API returned no snapshot of the Laserfiche URL. The El Paso County clerk results page lists only 2025 and 2026 files. The amlegal charter returned HTTP 403, the clerk news page returned a certificate error, and WebSearch was out of budget. No official document with names and totals could be opened.
